title: contextd Config
description: Canonical project/global config for contextd. Legacy wiki_root is accepted as an alias for knowledge_root during migration.

workspace.description: Active workspace identifier. This is a safe path segment, not a filesystem path.

default_workspace.description: Optional global default workspace identifier. null means no global default is selected.

knowledge_root.description: Logical knowledge root from config. It may be relative, absolute, or a symlink alias; the resolver emits and checks its canonical absolute target.

wiki_root.description: Legacy alias for knowledge_root. It intentionally accepts the same relative or absolute path forms.

packs.description: Local pack identifier override. null means follow workspace.md; an array has replace semantics. Invalid identifiers fail closed before path construction.

contextIdentifier.description: Portable workspace/pack identifier that is safe to use as one named path segment.
